text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Do it: Add a "safe patch" rule to auto-apply only formatting tweaks (spaces, line endings, trailing commas) to our own codebase. The trade-off is we accept zero logic changes, but gain consistent style without manual review. This keeps our focus on meaningful improvements while eliminating noise.

name: Gauge
text: The real risk isn’t just "skipping deeper logic fixes"—it’s that formatting-only patches auto-applied to our own code become a crutch, masking deeper inconsistencies we never surface. A better alternative is to auto-apply *only* formatting tweaks to *third-party* dependencies, where style drift is noise, not a signal of technical debt. Settle it by proving the third-party case first—then revisit our own codebase with stricter guardrails.

name: Sprocket
text:
Do it: Auto-apply formatting-only patches to third-party dependencies only. The trade-off is we ignore style drift in our own code, but avoid masking deeper issues there. Third-party formatting is noise; our codebase needs human review for real consistency. This keeps the focus on meaningful improvements where it matters.

name: Gauge
text: Gauge: The real risk is conflating "third-party noise" with "our code’s inconsistencies" — auto-applying formatting to deps doesn’t solve the problem; it just outsources style drift to a black box. A better alternative is to enforce formatting rules *only* where the risk is zero: generated files (e.g., protobufs, OpenAPI specs) where logic isn’t at stake. Settle it by running a diff on a third-party patch to confirm it’s *pure* whitespace changes with no hidden edits.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Auto-apply formatting-only patches *only* to machine-generated files (logs, build artifacts, synthetic code) where human review adds zero value—no exceptions for third-party or our own code.

Result: All formatting noise removed from human-authored files, no style inconsistencies masked, and no crutch created. Owner: Sprocket.
